evidenceBasedConclusions.conclusion: The most defensible current assessment is based on “Medicare Program; Inflation Reduction Act of 2022 (IRA) Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program Draft Guidance; Comment Request,” the strongest indexed record by source grade and evidence status.
evidenceBasedConclusions.evidence: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) is announcing an opportunity for the public to comment on CMS' draft guidance for the Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program regarding manufacturer effectuation of the maximum fair price in 2028 for the implementation of the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022 (IRA) (Pub. L. 117-169). CMS' draft guidance and other IRA-related guidance can be viewed on the CMS website at https://www.cms.gov/priorities/medicare- prescription-drug-affordability/medicare-prescription-drug- affordability. A dated source update exists and should be compared with prior records. This record should be preserved, cross-referenced and upgraded only if stronger evidence changes the finding.
evidenceBasedConclusions.limitations: One strong record cannot by itself prove a wider pattern, motive, conspiracy or command structure.
evidenceBasedConclusions.alternativeInterpretation: The record may have a narrower legal or factual meaning than the surrounding public narrative suggests.
